description: Submit a booking / staffing request to a Soundcheck organization on behalf of someone planning a live event. Creates a lead the org's team will follow up on. Requires organization_id, name, email, event_date, event_type, and location. If you're not certain the organization_id (slug or id) is correct, call get_public_org first to confirm it. If the user pasted messy event material, call analyze_event_to_uef first to draft UEF and see missing fields before booking.

event_type.description: the kind of event (e.g. wedding, festival, corporate, concert)

location.description: where the event is (city / venue / address)

message.description: what the requester needs (roles, headcount, details)

organization_id.description: the Soundcheck organization to send this booking/staffing request to (slug or id)

name: request_booking

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Request booking
